policy.scope: Exact SHA-256 document deduplication of D1-DATA-DERIVED-001 only.

identityAndGrouping.contentIdentity: SHA-256 of existing normalized UTF-8 document bytes, recomputed before grouping
identityAndGrouping.duplicateGroupDefinition: two or more input documents with the same recomputed content SHA-256

survivorSelection.method: Sort each duplicate group's members lexicographically by the tuple (sourceId, stableDocumentId); retain the first member.
survivorSelection.tieBehavior: Stable document IDs must be unique; collision fails closed.

output.writeBehavior: Write exact byte copies of survivor documents under source-specific document directories using stableDocumentId.txt filenames.

requiredValidation: every survivor is readable strict UTF-8 and nonempty
every survivor hash matches its recomputed input hash
no output content SHA-256 occurs more than once
input count equals survivors plus excluded excess duplicates
input bytes equal output bytes plus excluded duplicate bytes

nearDuplicateBoundary.reason: The locked D1 data-readiness blocker explicitly requires policy-governed near-duplicate measurement and adjudication in addition to exact deduplication.
